text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Cross-Border Railways (Fees) Regulations 2020 and come into operation on 14 September 2020.

heading.en: Fees for services rendered by LTA

text.en:
2. The fees specified in the second column of the First Schedule are payable to the LTA in respect of the services it renders specified opposite in the first column.
[S 690/2026 wef 29/09/2026]

heading.en: Fees for application for or to renew licences

text.en:
3. For the purposes of section 30(2)(b) of the Act, the application fee for an application for or to renew a licence is $100.
[S 690/2026 wef 29/09/2026]

heading.en: Fees for grant or renewal of licences

text.en:
4. For the purposes of section 31(1)(a)(i) and (ii) of the Act, the licence fee or renewal fee for the grant or renewal of a licence (as the case may be) is as specified in the Second Schedule.
[S 690/2026 wef 29/09/2026]

FIRST SCHEDULE
Regulation 2
Fees
First column
Second column
1.Answering any legal requisition regarding any property or lot
$10.90 in respect of each property or lot
2.Searching for any plan or map of the railway area
$21.80 for each plan or map
3.Supplying a photographic or other copy of a plan or map
(a)$10.90 for each copy of A0 size (841 mm × 1189 mm)
(b)$5.45 for each copy of any size smaller than A0 size
4.Supplying a monochromatic copy of a document without an attached plan or map
$1.09 for each page or part of a page
[S 4/2024 wef 01/01/2024]
[S 690/2026 wef 29/09/2026]
